0022600213.text: The LA Clippers (2-7, 0-4 on the road) are 13th in the West and fourth in the Pacific, six games back, heading into their 10th game of the season against the Phoenix Suns (3-5), who are 12th in the West, third in the Pacific, and riding a two-game win streak. The Clippers are without Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles surgery), Isaiah Jackson (groin soreness), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), while the Suns are missing Mark Williams (shoulder surgery). The teams have no games yet in the 2026-27 season series, having split 2-2 in the 2025-26 season series, and the Clippers won their last meeting 117-93 in Phoenix.
